nominal_target_mass_to_total_estimate.meaning: Target-mass estimate divided by Bradford total-protein estimate for the described stock; not validated purity or active fraction.

conditional_mass_denominator_factor.meaning: Would rescale a same-stock per-total-mass rate to per-estimated-target-mass only if the two mass estimates and sample linkage are valid. No rate is supplied or corrected here.

onepot_nominal_HFP_to_IMP_amount.meaning: Between-arm nominal molar amount difference accompanying the changed phosphatase identity; not an activity or recovery ratio.

control_panel_isomerization_positive_fra.meaning: Observed positive fraction in this five-preparation control panel; not a false-positive probability or confidence score for HFP.

reported_equilibrium_time_ratio_lower_bo.meaning: Bound on reported elapsed equilibrium times across differently prepared samples; not a kinetic or specific-activity ratio.
